reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing named virtual workspaces that combine multiple project directories and enable agent-assisted cross-directory file reading, searching, and modification with sidebar management.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中将多个项目目录组合为命名虚拟工作区，并支持智能体跨目录读取、搜索和修改文件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that combines multiple project directories into named virtual workspaces for agent-assisted cross-directory file reading, searching, and editing.

capabilities: Groups multiple project directories into named virtual workspaces
Reads, searches, lists, and edits files across workspace directories
Writes files subject to session sandbox boundaries and approval-based escalation
Provides sidebar and drawer UI for workspace management
